description: Unlock a customer who was locked out after too many failed sign-ins: clears the failed-attempt counter, `lockedUntil` and the sign-in throttle for that identity, so the next sign-in with the right password succeeds. Does not change the password and does not reinstate a suspended customer (that is unsuspend_customer, which also clears the lock).
name: unlock_customer
title: Unlock customer
